context_title:
Construct a complete, selfcontained, productionready JavaScript library and web component framework that implements a physicallyinspired realtime optical glass material system, a WebGL 1/2 rendering engine with dynamic quality scaling, an Oklabbased color science and automated WCAG contrast engine, an analytical spring physics and interaction system, and a comprehensive suite of accessible Custom Elements with an internal virtual DOM diffing engine.

The output must be provided as a single, unabridged, dependencyfree Universal Module Definition (UMD) file that executes identically in modern browser environments and degrades gracefully in headless/server environments. Every class, function, shader, CSS rule, and component must be fully implemented with zero placeholders, stubs, mocks, or omitted code.

Follow this exact specification from beginning to end:



 1. Architecture, Environment & Mathematical Foundations

1. Packaging & Environment Detection
    Wrap the entire codebase in a UMD closure exporting to module.exports if in a CommonJS environment, or binding to globalThis in browser/global environments.
    Implement rigorous runtime environment probes: isBrowser (window and document validation), isNode, dynamic device pixel ratio resolver dpr(), highprecision monotonic time getter now(), requestFrame/cancelFrame fallbacks, and a safe persistent storage abstraction (MemoryStorage fallback for localStorage).
    Implement an isolated, stronglytyped pub/sub EventBus (on, once, off, emit, clear, listenerCount) and a collisionfree unique identifier system with namespaced string parsing (uid, namespacedId, parseNamespacedId).

2. Core Mathematical Utilities
    Implement clamping, normalization, and interpolation functions: clamp, saturate, lerp, unlerp, remap, fract, smoothstep, smootherstep, Gaussian kernel evaluator gauss(x, sigma), exponential decay functions expDecay(lambda, dt) and damp(current, target, smoothing, dt), floatingpoint comparison approxEqual(a, b, eps), 2D vector operations (length2, distance2, dot2, normalize2), nonzero sign extraction signNonZero, step quantization roundTo, and DPR snapping against [1, 1.5, 2, 3].
    Implement binary search contrast lifting solver solveContrastLift(backdropLum, textLum, target) that iteratively determines the exact lightness modification needed to satisfy target contrast ratios.

3. Geometric Primitives & Operations
    Construct a mutable, chainable Rect class (x, y, w, h) containing:
      Accessors for right, bottom, centerX, centerY, area, isEmpty, minHalfExtent.
      Static constructors (zero, fromDOMRect).
      Transformation methods: set, copyFrom, clone, equals, point containment contains(px, py), collision intersects(o), uniform dilation expand(amount), mutable bounding union unionWith(o), intersection intersectWith(o), WebGL coordinate converter toGL(out, viewportHeight, scale), and Chebyshev/Euclidean boundary distance calculation surfaceDistanceTo(o).
    Construct polygon geometry utilities:
      polygonBounds(points): Calculates axisaligned bounding rectangles from flat coordinate arrays.
      polygonCentroid(points): Calculates arithmetic centers.
      normalizePolygon(points, rect): Transforms pixel coordinates into centerrelative $[1, 1]$ coordinate spaces.
      resamplePolygon(points, maxCount): Arclength parameterized polygon resampling algorithm reducing or expanding vertex lists to a fixed uniform count.
      rectFromCenter(cx, cy, w, h) and clampRectToViewport(rect, vw, vh, margin).

4. Color Science, Oklab Transformations & Perceptual Blending
    Implement gammaexact sRGB $\leftrightarrow$ Linear conversion for individual channels and RGBA vectors:
     $$\text{linear}(C) = \begin{cases} \frac{C}{12.92} & C \le 0.04045 \\ \left(\frac{C + 0.055}{1.055}\right)^{2.4} & C > 0.04045 \end{cases}$$
    Implement strict color string/array parsing supporting 3, 4, 6, and 8digit hexadecimal notations, rgb(), rgba(), and normalized/denormalized numeric arrays.
    Implement full forward and inverse transformations between Linear sRGB and the Oklab color space via intermediate LMS coordinates:
      Linear sRGB to LMS:
       $$\begin{bmatrix} L \\ M \\ S \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.4122214708 & 0.5363325363 & 0.0514459929 \\ 0.2119034982 & 0.6806995451 & 0.1073969566 \\ 0.0883024619 & 0.2817188376 & 0.6299787005 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} R \\ G \\ B \end{bmatrix}$$
      LMS nonlinearity: $L' = \sqrt[3]{L}, M' = \sqrt[3]{M}, S' = \sqrt[3]{S}$
      LMS to Oklab:
       $$\begin{bmatrix} L_{\text{ok}} \\ a_{\text{ok}} \\ b_{\text{ok}} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.2104542553 & 0.7936177850 & 0.0040720468 \\ 1.9779984951 & 2.4285922050 & 0.4505937099 \\ 0.0259040371 & 0.7827717662 & 0.8086757660 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} L' \\ M' \\ S' \end{bmatrix}$$
      Inverse matrix transformations converting Oklab back to Linear sRGB with negative luminance protection.
    Implement WCAG 2.1 relative luminance calculation ($0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B$ in linear space) and contrast ratio evaluation $\frac{L_1 + 0.05}{L_2 + 0.05}$.
    Implement premultiplication, unpremultiplication, linear interpolation, perceptual Oklab interpolation (mixOklab), Oklab chromatic tint blending preserving backdrop lightness (applyTint), and lightness modification in Oklab space (luminanceAdjustColor).

5. Analytical Spring Physics & Easing Engine
    Implement a highprecision CubicBezier easing solver using an 11point equidistant lookup table, NewtonRaphson firstderivative root finding ($\le 8$ iterations with slope threshold $10^{3}$), and a binary bisection fallback ($\le 32$ iterations with epsilon $10^{7}$). Expose standard presets: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut/standard, emphasized, decelerate, accelerate, overshoot, and step functions (steps).
    Implement multitrack keyframe systems: KeyframeTrack, KeyframeAnimator, and PhaseAnimator.
    Implement an exact, closedform analytical damped harmonic oscillator physics engine (SpringCurve and Spring):
      Parameterized by response time $T$ (undamped angular frequency $\omega_0 = \frac{2\pi}{T}$) and damping ratio $\zeta$.
      Implement separate exact solutions for:
       1. Underdamped ($\zeta < 1$): Damped frequency $\omega_d = \omega_0 \sqrt{1  \zeta^2}$, exponential envelope decay $e^{\zeta \omega_0 t}$, sinusoids for position and velocity.
       2. Critically damped ($\zeta = 1$): Degenerate solutions $(C_1 + C_2 t) e^{\omega_0 t}$ and its exact time derivative.
       3. Overdamped ($\zeta > 1$): Dual real roots $s_{1,2} = \omega_0 (\zeta \pm \sqrt{\zeta^2  1})$ with independent exponential superposition.
      Implement continuous target changes with smooth curvetocurve velocity preservation and duration blending (blendDuration). Provide static presets for smooth ($T=0.5, \zeta=1.0$), snappy ($T=0.3, \zeta=0.86$), and bouncy ($T=0.5, \zeta=0.6$).



 2. CPUSide Signed Distance Fields (SDF)

1. SDF Geometric Evaluation
    Implement exact distance functions on the CPU for geometry simulation, hit testing, and layout diagnostics:
      sdCircle(px, py, r)
      sdCapsule(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by, r)
      sdRoundedBox(px, py, hx, hy, rtl, rtr, rbr, rbl): Quadrantspecific corner radius selection with anisotropic box distance.
      sdSuperellipseBox(px, py, hx, hy, r, n): $L_n$norm superellipse boundary formulation ($n=4.0$).
      sdOrientedRoundedPolygon(px, py, pts, count, r): Vertex distance minimization and 2D crossingnumber winding calculation for internal/external sign.
2. Boolean Distance Blending
    Implement smooth polynomial minimum/maximum operators: opSmoothUnion(d1, d2, k), opSmoothUnionBlend(d1, d2, k) returning both distance and blend factor $h$, opSmoothSubtract(d1, d2, k), and opSmoothIntersect(d1, d2, k).
3. Differential Operators & Scene Hierarchy
    Implement analytical and numerical centraldifference gradient estimators (sdCircleGradient, sdRoundedBoxGradient, sdfGradientNum) and secondorder finite difference curvature estimators (sdfCurvatureNum).
    Implement SdfScene compound graph evaluator supporting arbitrary shape lists, spatial unions, raymarching queries, numerical normals, curvature evaluation, hit tests, and nearestneighbor search.



 3. Engine Infrastructure, Scheduling & Diagnostics

1. Hardware Capability Detection
    Construct Capabilities detecting: WebGL 2 vs WebGL 1, float/halffloat texture rendering extensions (EXT_color_buffer_float, EXT_color_buffer_half_float, WEBGL_color_buffer_float), derivative extensions (OES_standard_derivatives), parallel shader compilation (KHR_parallel_shader_compile), texture linear filtering capabilities, maximum texture dimensions, uniform vector limits, and hardware concurrency/memory performance classification (low, medium, high).
    Implement dynamic monitor refresh rate estimation via requestAnimationFrame timing analysis.
2. Configuration & Violation Diagnostics
    Construct Settings tracking: maxDPR, appearance mode overrides (auto, tinted, clear, solid), blur algorithm overrides, WCAG contrast targets ($4.5$ standard, $7.0$ high), window corner radii, and warning thresholds.
    Construct Logger featuring developer assertion checks and an internal circular violation registry (capacity 200) flagging structural and design rule failures: too-many-loose-shapes, too-many-containers, crowding (surface distance $< 8\text{px}$), clear-over-flat (clear variant placed over lowfrequency backgrounds), layer-violation (glass placed in content layer), and custom-background-override.
3. Dirty Tracking & Adaptive Frame Rate Scheduler
    Implement DirtyTracker aggregating percontainer shape and backdrop invalidation rectangles into minimal unified dirty bounding boxes, with settings and animation dirty flags.
    Implement RafScheduler operating a fixedtimestep physics accumulator ($120\text{ Hz}$, $\Delta t = 1/120\text{ s}$) with maximum substep caps, combined with a dynamic frame budget monitor ($16.7\text{ ms}$).
    Construct an automatic 4tier degradation system (tier 0 full fidelity to tier 3 maximum optimization) that monitors rolling frametime averages and automatically degrades (after $500\text{ ms}$ over budget) or restores (after $4000\text{ ms}$ under budget) pipeline features: DPR scaling, blur scaling, chromatic aberration, Fresnel rims, specular lobes, and drop shadows.



 4. Accessibility (a11y) & Adaptive Readability Engine

1. Media Preference & DOM Observation
    Implement Preferences managing live MediaQueryList listeners for prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast, forced-colors, prefers-color-scheme, and a MutationObserver tracking the root dir attribute (LTR/RTL). Provide programmatic override capabilities with instant event notifications.
2. Automated Contrast Correction & Focus Management
    Implement automated contrast compliance tools: contrastOf, meetsContrast, ensureContrast (Oklab lightness search adjusting foreground toward white or black depending on backdrop luminance until the required WCAG ratio is met), and textColorForSurface.
    Implement FocusRingManager dynamically adjusting focus stroke widths ($3\text{px}$ standard, $4\text{px}$ highcontrast), forcedcolor palette integration, and global keyboard vs pointer focus tracking (data-gk-keyboard-focus).
3. Keyboard Navigation & ARIA Primitives
    Implement RovingGroup managing accessible roving tabindex across collections of controls, complete with LTR/RTLaware arrow key navigation, Home/End support, wrapping, and activation handling.
    Implement FocusTrap for modal sheets, dialogs, and popovers with focus trapping, Shift+Tab wrapping, and restorefocusonexit functionality.
    Implement screen reader live region announcements (announce using polite and assertive hidden DOM nodes) and complete ARIA attribute manipulation helpers (setRole, setLabel, labelBy, describeBy, setExpanded, setPressed, setChecked, setSelected, setDisabled, setCurrent, setValueNow).



 5. Material System, Interactive Physics & Transitions

1. Material Descriptors & Concentric Corner Geometry
    Construct Tint (color vector, strength, CSS serialization), Glass (immutablestyle builder with .tint(), .interactive(), .variant(), supporting regular and clear descriptors), and ShapeDescriptor supporting capsule, circle, rounded rectangle with 4 independent corners, concentric rectangle, superellipse ($n=4$), and arbitrary polygons.
    Implement concentric radius geometry: $r_{\text{inner}} = \max(r_{\text{min}}, r_{\text{container}}  \text{inset})$, hierarchical container radius inheritance from ancestor DOM elements, and container corner offset calculations.
2. Fluid Morphing Transitions & Blended Unions
    Implement GlassTransition with specifications for matchedGeometry, materialize, identity, and custom functions.
    Implement TransitionDriver driving transitions with analytical springs, recording removal snapshots in a recent removal cache (retained for $450\text{ ms}$), and interpolating shape coordinates, dimensions, corner radii, tints, scale, and blur boosts.
    Implement UnionGroup and UnionRegistry calculating pairwise shape distances and dynamically expanding the blending radius (spacing) to allow adjacent glass elements to merge organically without surface crowding.
3. Interactive Physics Controller
    Implement InteractiveController binding pointer events (pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup, pointerenter, pointerleave, pointercancel) to independent analytical springs: press depth, hover state, normalized pointer X/Y coordinates, and elastic "jelly" rebound oscillation.
    Compute areadependent press scales ($0.96$ for small shapes, $0.98$ for large shapes $\ge 12000\text{px}^2$) and calculate velocitydependent damped sinusoidal wobble offsets on release.
4. Hardware Luminance Probe & Automated Readability Engine
    Construct LuminanceProbe utilizing WebGL to downsample the captured backdrop beneath active glass shapes into an $8 \times 8$ pixel atlas per shape.
    Implement GPUtoCPU reduction via singlepass asynchronous/synchronous readPixels, calculating 32bin luminance histograms, mean luminance, 10th percentile (P10), and 90th percentile (P90).
    Dynamically solve optimal luminosity adjustments and dimming opacities to ensure all text on glass meets or exceeds target contrast ratios, and apply the computed CSS color token --gk-on-glass directly to target DOM elements.



 6. Declarative UI Framework & Virtual DOM Engine

1. Virtual DOM Representation
    Implement a lightweight virtual DOM structure (makeVNode, hSelf, hSlot, makeText) supporting component selfreferencing (__self__), named and default slot projections (__slot__), keyed reconciliation, ref collection, and SVG namespace handling.
2. Reconciliation & Diffing Patcher
    Implement a diffing engine (patchHost, patchChildList, applyAttrs, patchChromeEntry, releaseEntry):
      Attribute diffing handling styles, class lists, boolean attributes, event listeners, and form control value synchronization without losing focus or cursor position.
      Keyed and unkeyed child list reconciliation with minimal DOM mutations and correct node reordering.
      Slotted child distribution preserving host light DOM nodes across dynamic rerenders.
3. Web Component Base Class
    Construct GkTag extending HTMLElement (or a safe fallback in nonbrowser environments) with lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, disconnectedCallback, mount, unmount, commit, _patch), reactive property accessors with automatic rerendering, and slot projection.



 7. WebGL Rendering Engine & Shader Infrastructure

1. WebGL Context & Resource Management
    Construct GLContextHost managing WebGL2 and WebGL1 contexts, handling webglcontextlost and webglcontextrestored, and configuring optimal blend states (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA).
    Implement an objectpooled Texture class managing texture allocation, resizing, filtering (linear/nearest/mipmap), wrap modes, pixel formatting, and DOM source uploads (HTMLCanvasElement, HTMLVideoElement, HTMLImageElement). Include texture memory statistics tracking.
    Implement Framebuffer wrapping textures with completeness validation, multilevel attachment, and viewport synchronization.
    Implement FullscreenQuad utilizing a single oversized NDC triangle ($[1, 1], [3, 1], [1, 3]$) to render screenspace passes without diagonal seam artifacts.
    Implement ShaderProgram and ProgramCache supporting uniform location caching, uniform setters (u1f, u2f, u3f, u4f, u1i, u1fv, u2fv, u4fv, uTexture), uniform buffer object bindings (UniformBlock indices for GlassBlock and PolyBlock), and parallel shader compilation (KHR_parallel_shader_compile).
2. Render Graph & Pass Pipeline
    Construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) RenderGraph and RenderPass system that performs topological dependency sorting, dirtyregion culling, and conditional pass execution.
    Implement the following rendering passes:
      BackdropCapture: Captures background elements (video, images, canvas, DOM snapshots) into an offscreen texture with aspectratio cover transformations.
      BlurPipeline: Multialgorithm blur pipeline selecting Gaussian blur (small radius), Kawase blur (medium radius), or a 6level downsample/upsample MIP chain (large radius). Implement WebGL2 hardware mipmap LOD sampling and WebGL1 duallevel texture blending.
      ShadowPass: Evaluates exponential drop shadows with geometric occlusion.
      GlassPass: Computes optical glass materials via fragmentlevel SDF raymarching and physical light interaction.
      HighlightPass: Renders inner specular edge illumination, hover highlights, and accessible focus rings.
      ScrollEdgePass: Renders progressive or hard blur bands at scroll container boundaries.
      BackgroundExtensionPass: Synthesizes blurred, mirrored backdrop extensions across window edges.
      IconPass: Specialized layer compositor utilizing 2D Euclidean Distance Transform (edt2d using parabolic envelope computation) for computing distance fields from arbitrary raster masks, simulating multilayer refraction, inner shadows, and specular lobes.
      CompositePass: Blits and colormanages linear output to the screen with Bayer $8 \times 8$ matrix dithering.
      CssFallbackRenderer: Pure CSS fallback utilizing -webkit-backdrop-filter, data attributes, and CSS variables when WebGL is unavailable or disabled.

3. GLSL Shaders (Implement both complete WebGL 2 GLSL ES 3.00 and WebGL 1 GLSL ES 1.00 versions)
    quad.vert: Vertex shader with uDrawRect scaling.
    common: Math constants, Oklab/sRGB transformations, UBO layouts (GlassBlock, PolyBlock) or data texture samplers, unpacked shape data extractors (gkRect, gkRadii, gkTint, gkShadow, gkA, gkB, gkC, gkD, gkE, gkF), polygon vertex accessors, coverage antialiasing (fwidth), and LOD blur samplers.
    sdf: Complete GPU implementations of sdCircle, sdCapsule, sdRoundedBox, sdSuperellipseBox, sdOrientedRoundedPolygon, opSmoothUnion, opSmoothUnionBlend, opSmoothSubtract, opSmoothIntersect, scene SDF loops, and finitedifference gradient/curvature evaluators.
    glass.frag & glass-clear.frag:
      Computes combined scene distance and blends tint colors.
      Calculates edge bevel profile:
       $$\text{edgeT} = (1.0  \text{clamp}(d / \text{edgePx}, 0.0, 1.0))^{\text{bevelExp}}$$
      Injects pointer interaction dent depression.
      Evaluates surface normals $N = \text{normalize}(\text{vec3}(n \cdot \text{edgeT} \cdot \text{refractionStrength}, \sqrt{1  \text{edgeT}^2}))$.
      Computes Snell's law refraction vector $\mathbf{R} = \text{refract}(\mathbf{V}, \mathbf{N}, 1/\text{IOR})$.
      Performs 3tap chromatic aberration sampling (separate red, green, blue texture offsets).
      Computes Fresnel reflections:
       $$\text{Fresnel} = (1.0  \text{clamp}(\mathbf{N} \cdot (0, 0, 1), 0.0, 1.0))^{\text{FRESNEL\_POWER}}$$
      Computes dualsource specular highlights with BlinnPhong lobes and secondorder curvature modulation:
       $$\text{spec} = (\mathbf{N} \cdot \mathbf{H})^{\text{sharpness}} \cdot \text{intensity}$$
      Applies perceptual Oklab tinting, dynamic luminosity adjustments, dimming opacity, and edge antialiasing.
    shadow.frag: Exponential falloff drop shadow shader evaluated from shape distance fields.
    highlight.frag: Inner stroke lighting and accessible focus ring shader.
    downsample.frag / upsample.frag: 13tap downsampling and 9tap upsampling filter kernels.
    gaussian-blur.frag & kawase-blur.frag: Separable Gaussian and Kawase blur kernels.
    luminance-reduce.frag: $4 \times 4$ grid averaging kernel downsampling regions to $8 \times 8$.
    scroll-edge.frag & background-extension.frag: Edge blur attenuation and mirrored seam synthesis.
    icon-layer.frag: Maskdriven multilayer icon lighting with refraction, inner shadow, and specular lobes.
    composite.frag: Final blit with LineartosRGB transfer and 8x8 Bayer dithering.



 8. Layout Engine, Metrics & Design Tokens

1. Dynamic Type & Metrics Engine
    Implement LayoutMetrics defining a 12tier Dynamic Type scale (xSmall through accessibility5) across 9 text styles (body, headline, subheadline, title1, title2, title3, footnote, caption1, caption2).
    Provide scaled metric computation, minimum hit target enforcement ($44\text{px}$ touch target compliance), and standardized component height calculations.
2. Safe Area & Adaptive Layout Systems
    Implement SafeAreaManager managing dynamic top, bottom, leading, and trailing safearea insets.
    Implement ResizeController solving multicolumn proportional split layouts, handle dragging, and prioritybased column collapsing.
    Implement ScrollViewModel supporting scrolldriven transforms (opacity and scale interpolation), pagination snapping, and scroll edge blur coordination.
3. Global Design System Stylesheet (GK_STYLES)
    Embed a comprehensive CSS stylesheet containing:
      Strict CSS reset and boxsizing rules.
      Light and dark theme CSS custom properties (--gk-accent, --gk-text, --gk-surface, --gk-hairline, --gk-on-glass, --gk-fill, --gk-track, --gk-separator, etc.).
      Media query overrides for prefers-color-scheme: dark, prefers-contrast: more, and forced-colors: active.
      Complete layout and structural styling for all custom elements.
      Comprehensive CSS fallback styles ([data-gk-renderer-mode='css']) implementing frosted glass via backdrop-filter, multilayer gradient borders, and simulated inner bevels.



 9. Complete UI Component Suite

Implement all of the following Custom Elements as subclasses of GkTag, complete with reactive attribute getters/setters, lifecycle management, keyboard navigation, ARIA states, glass material registration, and child/slot rendering:

1. GkGlassContainer (<gk-glass-container>):
    Grouping container managing spatial shape unions, uniform buffer packing, and multishape draw call batching.
2. GkButton (<gk-button>):
    Push button supporting variants (plain, bordered, glass, glassProminent, glassClear, glassProminentClear), sizes (mini, small, regular, large, xl), leading/trailing icons, loading spinner state, disabled states, custom tints, and keyboard activation (Enter, Space).
3. GkToggle (<gk-toggle>):
    Switch, checkbox, and togglebutton control featuring interactive drag physics, transient glass knob registration, velocitybased flick gesture recognition, indeterminate states, and accessible ARIA switch attributes.
4. GkSlider (<gk-slider>):
    Singlethumb and dualthumb range slider supporting horizontal/vertical orientations, discrete tick quantization, live value displays, transient glass thumb physics, pointer dragging, and keyboard step adjustment (Arrow, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End).
5. GkStepper (<gk-stepper>):
    Segmented numeric stepper with increment/decrement buttons, continuous pressandhold acceleration, min/max clamping, ARIA spinbutton semantics, and live region announcements.
6. GkSegmentedControl (<gk-segmented-control>):
    Multioption selector with an animated sliding background indicator pill, roving keyboard focus, and glass container registration.
7. GkPicker (<gk-picker>):
    Selection control supporting dropdown menu, segmented, inline horizontal radio group, and 3D wheel listbox presentations.
8. GkTextField (<gk-text-field>):
    Text input supporting autocomplete suggestion popups, tokenized multivalue tag lists, floating suggestion listboxes, keyboard navigation, and virtual keyboard avoidance integration.
9. GkSearchField (<gk-search-field>):
    Specialized search input with leading search icon, clear button, suggestion dropdown, and search event dispatch.
10. GkProgress (<gk-progress>):
     Linear and circular progress indicators supporting determinate percentage widths/arcs and animated indeterminate modes.
11. GkTabBar & GkTabItem (<gk-tab-bar>, <gk-tab-item>):
     Floating bottom tab navigation bar featuring matched geometry glass selection pill transitions, scrolldriven autominimization (minimizeBehavior), separated search tabs, and responsive layout adaptation.
12. GkToolbar, GkToolbarItem, GkToolbarGroup, GkToolbarSpacer (<gk-toolbar>, etc.):
     Header/footer toolbars with automatic item overflow detection, dropdown overflow menus, grouped glass pill containers, fixed/flexible spacers, and icononly/labeled items.
13. GkMenu, GkMenuItem, GkContextMenu (<gk-menu>, etc.):
     Nested hierarchical popup and context menus supporting item icons, keyboard shortcuts (⌘), checkmark toggles, destructive styling, separator items, submenu cascading, and clickoutside dismissal.
14. GkPopover (<gk-popover>):
     Anchored floating popover dialog with dynamic arrow placement (top/bottom), viewport collision boundary clamping, and clickoutside dismissal.
15. GkSheet & GkActionSheet (<gk-sheet>, <gk-action-sheet>):
     Modal bottom sheets supporting detents (medium, large, fractional), dragtodismiss gesture physics with velocity flick recognition, grabber handle, and action sheet button groups.
16. GkAlert (<gk-alert>):
     Modal alert dialog featuring title, message, structured action buttons (cancel, destructive, default), focus trapping, and screen reader announcements.
17. GkList, GkListRow, GkListRowSeparator, GkSection (<gk-list>, etc.):
     Grouped and inset list views supporting single/multiple selection, roving keyboard navigation, section headers with titlecasing enforcement, section footers, leading/trailing accessories, disclosure chevrons, and interactive swipetoreveal action buttons (beginSwipe, positionSwipe, settleSwipe).
18. GkForm & GkFormRow (<gk-form>, <gk-form-row>):
     Structured form layout container supporting multicolumn responsive grid alignment, automatic labeltocontrol ID pairing (aria-labelledby), and description hints.
19. GkCard (<gk-card>):
     Container card supporting media slots, titles, subtitles, interactive glass hover/press physics, custom tints, and link navigation.
20. GkBadge (<gk-badge>):
     Notification badge supporting numeric counts with overflow caps (99+), unread dot presentation, and 3D rolling odometer vertical digit transition columns.
21. GkTooltip (<gk-tooltip>):
     Timed dwell hover/focus tooltip with automatic viewport edge collision avoidance and pointer enter/leave lifecycle management.
22. GkIcon (<gk-icon>):
     Vector iconography component with a builtin library of 40+ SVG symbols, rendering at multiple weights (thin, regular, medium, bold) and scales (small, medium, large).
23. GkAppIcon (<gk-app-icon>):
     Multilayer application icon renderer supporting superellipse and circular squircle masks, GPU/CPU compositing via Euclidean distance transforms, multilayer specular highlights, inner shadows, and light/dark/tinted/clear preview generation.
24. GkSplitView, GkPane, GkInspector, GkScrollView, GkSafeBar, GkWindowFrame (<gk-split-view>, etc.):
     Structural application layout primitives providing draggable multipane split views, collapsible inspector sidebars, scroll views with scrolldriven item transforms, sticky safearea bars, and rounded window frames.



 10. Public API Surface & Global Lifecycle

1. Master API Class & Singleton Export
    Construct the master API entry point exposing:
      Properties: version, settings, preferences, safeArea, metrics, Glass, Shape, GlassTransition, ScrollEdgeEffect, BackgroundExtension, and quality (tier getter/setter).
      mount(root, options): Initializes the WebGL canvas, starts the render scheduler, attaches resize and mutation observers, initializes accessibility listeners, and mounts global styling.
      unmount(): Disposes of the renderer, cleans up all WebGL resources, detaches observers, and resets registries.
      effect(el, glass, shape, opts): Directly binds glass materials to arbitrary DOM elements and returns a disposable handle.
      removeEffect(el): Removes glass bindings.
      audit(): Executes a comprehensive accessibility and performance audit across all active surfaces, returning violation counts, contrast measurements, and surface inventories.
2. Custom Element Registration
    Guard against duplicate registration and register all 40+ Custom Elements under the customElements registry using the gk-* tag prefix.
3. Execution & Return
    Ensure the module returns the master API singleton, cleanly packaged for immediate execution in any modern browser or modular environment.

      polygonCentroid(points): Calculates arithmetic centers.
      normalizePolygon(points, rect): Transforms pixel coordinates into centerrelative $[1, 1]$ coordinate spaces.
      resamplePolygon(points, maxCount): Arclength parameterized polygon resampling algorithm reducing or expanding vertex lists to a fixed uniform count.
      rectFromCenter(cx, cy, w, h) and clampRectToViewport(rect, vw, vh, margin).

4. Color Science, Oklab Transformations & Perceptual Blending
    Implement gammaexact sRGB $\leftrightarrow$ Linear conversion for individual channels and RGBA vectors:
     $$\text{linear}(C) = \begin{cases} \frac{C}{12.92} & C \le 0.04045 \\ \left(\frac{C + 0.055}{1.055}\right)^{2.4} & C > 0.04045 \end{cases}$$
    Implement strict color string/array parsing supporting 3, 4, 6, and 8digit hexadecimal notations, rgb(), rgba(), and normalized/denormalized numeric arrays.
    Implement full forward and inverse transformations between Linear sRGB and the Oklab color space via intermediate LMS coordinates:
      Linear sRGB to LMS:
       $$\begin{bmatrix} L \\ M \\ S \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.4122214708 & 0.5363325363 & 0.0514459929 \\ 0.2119034982 & 0.6806995451 & 0.1073969566 \\ 0.0883024619 & 0.2817188376 & 0.6299787005 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} R \\ G \\ B \end{bmatrix}$$
      LMS nonlinearity: $L' = \sqrt[3]{L}, M' = \sqrt[3]{M}, S' = \sqrt[3]{S}$
      LMS to Oklab:
       $$\begin{bmatrix} L_{\text{ok}} \\ a_{\text{ok}} \\ b_{\text{ok}} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0.2104542553 & 0.7936177850 & 0.0040720468 \\ 1.9779984951 & 2.4285922050 & 0.4505937099 \\ 0.0259040371 & 0.7827717662 & 0.8086757660 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} L' \\ M' \\ S' \end{bmatrix}$$
      Inverse matrix transformations converting Oklab back to Linear sRGB with negative luminance protection.
    Implement WCAG 2.1 relative luminance calculation ($0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B$ in linear space) and contrast ratio evaluation $\frac{L_1 + 0.05}{L_2 + 0.05}$.
    Implement premultiplication, unpremultiplication, linear interpolation, perceptual Oklab interpolation (mixOklab), Oklab chromatic tint blending preserving backdrop lightness (applyTint), and lightness modification in Oklab space (luminanceAdjustColor).

5. Analytical Spring Physics & Easing Engine
    Implement a highprecision CubicBezier easing solver using an 11point equidistant lookup table, NewtonRaphson firstderivative root finding ($\le 8$ iterations with slope threshold $10^{3}$), and a binary bisection fallback ($\le 32$ iterations with epsilon $10^{7}$). Expose standard presets: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut/standard, emphasized, decelerate, accelerate, overshoot, and step functions (steps).
    Implement multitrack keyframe systems: KeyframeTrack, KeyframeAnimator, and PhaseAnimator.
    Implement an exact, closedform analytical damped harmonic oscillator physics engine (SpringCurve and Spring):
      Parameterized by response time $T$ (undamped angular frequency $\omega_0 = \frac{2\pi}{T}$) and damping ratio $\zeta$.
      Implement separate exact solutions for:
       1. Underdamped ($\zeta < 1$): Damped frequency $\omega_d = \omega_0 \sqrt{1  \zeta^2}$, exponential envelope decay $e^{\zeta \omega_0 t}$, sinusoids for position and velocity.
       2. Critically damped ($\zeta = 1$): Degenerate solutions $(C_1 + C_2 t) e^{\omega_0 t}$ and its exact time derivative.
       3. Overdamped ($\zeta > 1$): Dual real roots $s_{1,2} = \omega_0 (\zeta \pm \sqrt{\zeta^2  1})$ with independent exponential superposition.
      Implement continuous target changes with smooth curvetocurve velocity preservation and duration blending (blendDuration). Provide static presets for smooth ($T=0.5, \zeta=1.0$), snappy ($T=0.3, \zeta=0.86$), and bouncy ($T=0.5, \zeta=0.6$).



 2. CPUSide Signed Distance Fields (SDF)

1. SDF Geometric Evaluation
    Implement exact distance functions on the CPU for geometry simulation, hit testing, and layout diagnostics:
      sdCircle(px, py, r)
      sdCapsule(px, py, ax, ay, bx, by, r)
      sdRoundedBox(px, py, hx, hy, rtl, rtr, rbr, rbl): Quadrantspecific corner radius selection with anisotropic box distance.
      sdSuperellipseBox(px, py, hx, hy, r, n): $L_n$norm superellipse boundary formulation ($n=4.0$).
      sdOrientedRoundedPolygon(px, py, pts, count, r): Vertex distance minimization and 2D crossingnumber winding calculation for internal/external sign.
2. Boolean Distance Blending
    Implement smooth polynomial minimum/maximum operators: opSmoothUnion(d1, d2, k), opSmoothUnionBlend(d1, d2, k) returning both distance and blend factor $h$, opSmoothSubtract(d1, d2, k), and opSmoothIntersect(d1, d2, k).
3. Differential Operators & Scene Hierarchy
    Implement analytical and numerical centraldifference gradient estimators (sdCircleGradient, sdRoundedBoxGradient, sdfGradientNum) and secondorder finite difference curvature estimators (sdfCurvatureNum).
    Implement SdfScene compound graph evaluator supporting arbitrary shape lists, spatial unions, raymarching queries, numerical normals, curvature evaluation, hit tests, and nearestneighbor search.



 3. Engine Infrastructure, Scheduling & Diagnostics

1. Hardware Capability Detection
    Construct Capabilities detecting: WebGL 2 vs WebGL 1, float/halffloat texture rendering extensions (EXT_color_buffer_float, EXT_color_buffer_half_float, WEBGL_color_buffer_float), derivative extensions (OES_standard_derivatives), parallel shader compilation (KHR_parallel_shader_compile), texture linear filtering capabilities, maximum texture dimensions, uniform vector limits, and hardware concurrency/memory performance classification (low, medium, high).
    Implement dynamic monitor refresh rate estimation via requestAnimationFrame timing analysis.
2. Configuration & Violation Diagnostics
    Construct Settings tracking: maxDPR, appearance mode overrides (auto, tinted, clear, solid), blur algorithm overrides, WCAG contrast targets ($4.5$ standard, $7.0$ high), window corner radii, and warning thresholds.
    Construct Logger featuring developer assertion checks and an internal circular violation registry (capacity 200) flagging structural and design rule failures: too-many-loose-shapes, too-many-containers, crowding (surface distance $< 8\text{px}$), clear-over-flat (clear variant placed over lowfrequency backgrounds), layer-violation (glass placed in content layer), and custom-background-override.
3. Dirty Tracking & Adaptive Frame Rate Scheduler
    Implement DirtyTracker aggregating percontainer shape and backdrop invalidation rectangles into minimal unified dirty bounding boxes, with settings and animation dirty flags.
    Implement RafScheduler operating a fixedtimestep physics accumulator ($120\text{ Hz}$, $\Delta t = 1/120\text{ s}$) with maximum substep caps, combined with a dynamic frame budget monitor ($16.7\text{ ms}$).
    Construct an automatic 4tier degradation system (tier 0 full fidelity to tier 3 maximum optimization) that monitors rolling frametime averages and automatically degrades (after $500\text{ ms}$ over budget) or restores (after $4000\text{ ms}$ under budget) pipeline features: DPR scaling, blur scaling, chromatic aberration, Fresnel rims, specular lobes, and drop shadows.



 4. Accessibility (a11y) & Adaptive Readability Engine

1. Media Preference & DOM Observation
    Implement Preferences managing live MediaQueryList listeners for prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast, forced-colors, prefers-color-scheme, and a MutationObserver tracking the root dir attribute (LTR/RTL). Provide programmatic override capabilities with instant event notifications.
2. Automated Contrast Correction & Focus Management
    Implement automated contrast compliance tools: contrastOf, meetsContrast, ensureContrast (Oklab lightness search adjusting foreground toward white or black depending on backdrop luminance until the required WCAG ratio is met), and textColorForSurface.
    Implement FocusRingManager dynamically adjusting focus stroke widths ($3\text{px}$ standard, $4\text{px}$ highcontrast), forcedcolor palette integration, and global keyboard vs pointer focus tracking (data-gk-keyboard-focus).
3. Keyboard Navigation & ARIA Primitives
    Implement RovingGroup managing accessible roving tabindex across collections of controls, complete with LTR/RTLaware arrow key navigation, Home/End support, wrapping, and activation handling.
    Implement FocusTrap for modal sheets, dialogs, and popovers with focus trapping, Shift+Tab wrapping, and restorefocusonexit functionality.
    Implement screen reader live region announcements (announce using polite and assertive hidden DOM nodes) and complete ARIA attribute manipulation helpers (setRole, setLabel, labelBy, describeBy, setExpanded, setPressed, setChecked, setSelected, setDisabled, setCurrent, setValueNow).



 5. Material System, Interactive Physics & Transitions

1. Material Descriptors & Concentric Corner Geometry
    Construct Tint (color vector, strength, CSS serialization), Glass (immutablestyle builder with .tint(), .interactive(), .variant(), supporting regular and clear descriptors), and ShapeDescriptor supporting capsule, circle, rounded rectangle with 4 independent corners, concentric rectangle, superellipse ($n=4$), and arbitrary polygons.
    Implement concentric radius geometry: $r_{\text{inner}} = \max(r_{\text{min}}, r_{\text{container}}  \text{inset})$, hierarchical container radius inheritance from ancestor DOM elements, and container corner offset calculations.
2. Fluid Morphing Transitions & Blended Unions
    Implement GlassTransition with specifications for matchedGeometry, materialize, identity, and custom functions.
    Implement TransitionDriver driving transitions with analytical springs, recording removal snapshots in a recent removal cache (retained for $450\text{ ms}$), and interpolating shape coordinates, dimensions, corner radii, tints, scale, and blur boosts.
    Implement UnionGroup and UnionRegistry calculating pairwise shape distances and dynamically expanding the blending radius (spacing) to allow adjacent glass elements to merge organically without surface crowding.
3. Interactive Physics Controller
    Implement InteractiveController binding pointer events (pointerdown, pointermove, pointerup, pointerenter, pointerleave, pointercancel) to independent analytical springs: press depth, hover state, normalized pointer X/Y coordinates, and elastic "jelly" rebound oscillation.
    Compute areadependent press scales ($0.96$ for small shapes, $0.98$ for large shapes $\ge 12000\text{px}^2$) and calculate velocitydependent damped sinusoidal wobble offsets on release.
4. Hardware Luminance Probe & Automated Readability Engine
    Construct LuminanceProbe utilizing WebGL to downsample the captured backdrop beneath active glass shapes into an $8 \times 8$ pixel atlas per shape.
    Implement GPUtoCPU reduction via singlepass asynchronous/synchronous readPixels, calculating 32bin luminance histograms, mean luminance, 10th percentile (P10), and 90th percentile (P90).
    Dynamically solve optimal luminosity adjustments and dimming opacities to ensure all text on glass meets or exceeds target contrast ratios, and apply the computed CSS color token --gk-on-glass directly to target DOM elements.



 6. Declarative UI Framework & Virtual DOM Engine

1. Virtual DOM Representation
    Implement a lightweight virtual DOM structure (makeVNode, hSelf, hSlot, makeText) supporting component selfreferencing (__self__), named and default slot projections (__slot__), keyed reconciliation, ref collection, and SVG namespace handling.
2. Reconciliation & Diffing Patcher
    Implement a diffing engine (patchHost, patchChildList, applyAttrs, patchChromeEntry, releaseEntry):
      Attribute diffing handling styles, class lists, boolean attributes, event listeners, and form control value synchronization without losing focus or cursor position.
      Keyed and unkeyed child list reconciliation with minimal DOM mutations and correct node reordering.
      Slotted child distribution preserving host light DOM nodes across dynamic rerenders.
3. Web Component Base Class
    Construct GkTag extending HTMLElement (or a safe fallback in nonbrowser environments) with lifecycle hooks (connectedCallback, disconnectedCallback, mount, unmount, commit, _patch), reactive property accessors with automatic rerendering, and slot projection.



 7. WebGL Rendering Engine & Shader Infrastructure

1. WebGL Context & Resource Management
    Construct GLContextHost managing WebGL2 and WebGL1 contexts, handling webglcontextlost and webglcontextrestored, and configuring optimal blend states (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA).
    Implement an objectpooled Texture class managing texture allocation, resizing, filtering (linear/nearest/mipmap), wrap modes, pixel formatting, and DOM source uploads (HTMLCanvasElement, HTMLVideoElement, HTMLImageElement). Include texture memory statistics tracking.
    Implement Framebuffer wrapping textures with completeness validation, multilevel attachment, and viewport synchronization.
    Implement FullscreenQuad utilizing a single oversized NDC triangle ($[1, 1], [3, 1], [1, 3]$) to render screenspace passes without diagonal seam artifacts.
    Implement ShaderProgram and ProgramCache supporting uniform location caching, uniform setters (u1f, u2f, u3f, u4f, u1i, u1fv, u2fv, u4fv, uTexture), uniform buffer object bindings (UniformBlock indices for GlassBlock and PolyBlock), and parallel shader compilation (KHR_parallel_shader_compile).
2. Render Graph & Pass Pipeline
    Construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) RenderGraph and RenderPass system that performs topological dependency sorting, dirtyregion culling, and conditional pass execution.
    Implement the following rendering passes:
      BackdropCapture: Captures background elements (video, images, canvas, DOM snapshots) into an offscreen texture with aspectratio cover transformations.
      BlurPipeline: Multialgorithm blur pipeline selecting Gaussian blur (small radius), Kawase blur (medium radius), or a 6level downsample/upsample MIP chain (large radius). Implement WebGL2 hardware mipmap LOD sampling and WebGL1 duallevel texture blending.
      ShadowPass: Evaluates exponential drop shadows with geometric occlusion.
      GlassPass: Computes optical glass materials via fragmentlevel SDF raymarching and physical light interaction.
      HighlightPass: Renders inner specular edge illumination, hover highlights, and accessible focus rings.
      ScrollEdgePass: Renders progressive or hard blur bands at scroll container boundaries.
      BackgroundExtensionPass: Synthesizes blurred, mirrored backdrop extensions across window edges.
      IconPass: Specialized layer compositor utilizing 2D Euclidean Distance Transform (edt2d using parabolic envelope computation) for computing distance fields from arbitrary raster masks, simulating multilayer refraction, inner shadows, and specular lobes.
      CompositePass: Blits and colormanages linear output to the screen with Bayer $8 \times 8$ matrix dithering.
      CssFallbackRenderer: Pure CSS fallback utilizing -webkit-backdrop-filter, data attributes, and CSS variables when WebGL is unavailable or disabled.

3. GLSL Shaders (Implement both complete WebGL 2 GLSL ES 3.00 and WebGL 1 GLSL ES 1.00 versions)
    quad.vert: Vertex shader with uDrawRect scaling.
    common: Math constants, Oklab/sRGB transformations, UBO layouts (GlassBlock, PolyBlock) or data texture samplers, unpacked shape data extractors (gkRect, gkRadii, gkTint, gkShadow, gkA, gkB, gkC, gkD, gkE, gkF), polygon vertex accessors, coverage antialiasing (fwidth), and LOD blur samplers.
    sdf: Complete GPU implementations of sdCircle, sdCapsule, sdRoundedBox, sdSuperellipseBox, sdOrientedRoundedPolygon, opSmoothUnion, opSmoothUnionBlend, opSmoothSubtract, opSmoothIntersect, scene SDF loops, and finitedifference gradient/curvature evaluators.
    glass.frag & glass-clear.frag:
      Computes combined scene distance and blends tint colors.
      Calculates edge bevel profile:
       $$\text{edgeT} = (1.0  \text{clamp}(d / \text{edgePx}, 0.0, 1.0))^{\text{bevelExp}}$$
      Injects pointer interaction dent depression.
      Evaluates surface normals $N = \text{normalize}(\text{vec3}(n \cdot \text{edgeT} \cdot \text{refractionStrength}, \sqrt{1  \text{edgeT}^2}))$.
      Computes Snell's law refraction vector $\mathbf{R} = \text{refract}(\mathbf{V}, \mathbf{N}, 1/\text{IOR})$.
      Performs 3tap chromatic aberration sampling (separate red, green, blue texture offsets).
      Computes Fresnel reflections:
       $$\text{Fresnel} = (1.0  \text{clamp}(\mathbf{N} \cdot (0, 0, 1), 0.0, 1.0))^{\text{FRESNEL\_POWER}}$$
      Computes dualsource specular highlights with BlinnPhong lobes and secondorder curvature modulation:
       $$\text{spec} = (\mathbf{N} \cdot \mathbf{H})^{\text{sharpness}} \cdot \text{intensity}$$
      Applies perceptual Oklab tinting, dynamic luminosity adjustments, dimming opacity, and edge antialiasing.
    shadow.frag: Exponential falloff drop shadow shader evaluated from shape distance fields.
    highlight.frag: Inner stroke lighting and accessible focus ring shader.
    downsample.frag / upsample.frag: 13tap downsampling and 9tap upsampling filter kernels.
    gaussian-blur.frag & kawase-blur.frag: Separable Gaussian and Kawase blur kernels.
    luminance-reduce.frag: $4 \times 4$ grid averaging kernel downsampling regions to $8 \times 8$.
    scroll-edge.frag & background-extension.frag: Edge blur attenuation and mirrored seam synthesis.
    icon-layer.frag: Maskdriven multilayer icon lighting with refraction, inner shadow, and specular lobes.
    composite.frag: Final blit with LineartosRGB transfer and 8x8 Bayer dithering.



 8. Layout Engine, Metrics & Design Tokens

1. Dynamic Type & Metrics Engine
    Implement LayoutMetrics defining a 12tier Dynamic Type scale (xSmall through accessibility5) across 9 text styles (body, headline, subheadline, title1, title2, title3, footnote, caption1, caption2).
    Provide scaled metric computation, minimum hit target enforcement ($44\text{px}$ touch target compliance), and standardized component height calculations.
2. Safe Area & Adaptive Layout Systems
    Implement SafeAreaManager managing dynamic top, bottom, leading, and trailing safearea insets.
    Implement ResizeController solving multicolumn proportional split layouts, handle dragging, and prioritybased column collapsing.
    Implement ScrollViewModel supporting scrolldriven transforms (opacity and scale interpolation), pagination snapping, and scroll edge blur coordination.
3. Global Design System Stylesheet (GK_STYLES)
    Embed a comprehensive CSS stylesheet containing:
      Strict CSS reset and boxsizing rules.
      Light and dark theme CSS custom properties (--gk-accent, --gk-text, --gk-surface, --gk-hairline, --gk-on-glass, --gk-fill, --gk-track, --gk-separator, etc.).
      Media query overrides for prefers-color-scheme: dark, prefers-contrast: more, and forced-colors: active.
      Complete layout and structural styling for all custom elements.
      Comprehensive CSS fallback styles ([data-gk-renderer-mode='css']) implementing frosted glass via backdrop-filter, multilayer gradient borders, and simulated inner bevels.



 9. Complete UI Component Suite

Implement all of the following Custom Elements as subclasses of GkTag, complete with reactive attribute getters/setters, lifecycle management, keyboard navigation, ARIA states, glass material registration, and child/slot rendering:

1. GkGlassContainer (<gk-glass-container>):
    Grouping container managing spatial shape unions, uniform buffer packing, and multishape draw call batching.
2. GkButton (<gk-button>):
    Push button supporting variants (plain, bordered, glass, glassProminent, glassClear, glassProminentClear), sizes (mini, small, regular, large, xl), leading/trailing icons, loading spinner state, disabled states, custom tints, and keyboard activation (Enter, Space).
3. GkToggle (<gk-toggle>):
    Switch, checkbox, and togglebutton control featuring interactive drag physics, transient glass knob registration, velocitybased flick gesture recognition, indeterminate states, and accessible ARIA switch attributes.
4. GkSlider (<gk-slider>):
    Singlethumb and dualthumb range slider supporting horizontal/vertical orientations, discrete tick quantization, live value displays, transient glass thumb physics, pointer dragging, and keyboard step adjustment (Arrow, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End).
5. GkStepper (<gk-stepper>):
    Segmented numeric stepper with increment/decrement buttons, continuous pressandhold acceleration, min/max clamping, ARIA spinbutton semantics, and live region announcements.
6. GkSegmentedControl (<gk-segmented-control>):
    Multioption selector with an animated sliding background indicator pill, roving keyboard focus, and glass container registration.
7. GkPicker (<gk-picker>):
    Selection control supporting dropdown menu, segmented, inline horizontal radio group, and 3D wheel listbox presentations.
8. GkTextField (<gk-text-field>):
    Text input supporting autocomplete suggestion popups, tokenized multivalue tag lists, floating suggestion listboxes, keyboard navigation, and virtual keyboard avoidance integration.
9. GkSearchField (<gk-search-field>):
    Specialized search input with leading search icon, clear button, suggestion dropdown, and search event dispatch.
10. GkProgress (<gk-progress>):
     Linear and circular progress indicators supporting determinate percentage widths/arcs and animated indeterminate modes.
11. GkTabBar & GkTabItem (<gk-tab-bar>, <gk-tab-item>):
     Floating bottom tab navigation bar featuring matched geometry glass selection pill transitions, scrolldriven autominimization (minimizeBehavior), separated search tabs, and responsive layout adaptation.
12. GkToolbar, GkToolbarItem, GkToolbarGroup, GkToolbarSpacer (<gk-toolbar>, etc.):
     Header/footer toolbars with automatic item overflow detection, dropdown overflow menus, grouped glass pill containers, fixed/flexible spacers, and icononly/labeled items.
13. GkMenu, GkMenuItem, GkContextMenu (<gk-menu>, etc.):
     Nested hierarchical popup and context menus supporting item icons, keyboard shortcuts (⌘), checkmark toggles, destructive styling, separator items, submenu cascading, and clickoutside dismissal.
14. GkPopover (<gk-popover>):
     Anchored floating popover dialog with dynamic arrow placement (top/bottom), viewport collision boundary clamping, and clickoutside dismissal.
15. GkSheet & GkActionSheet (<gk-sheet>, <gk-action-sheet>):
     Modal bottom sheets supporting detents (medium, large, fractional), dragtodismiss gesture physics with velocity flick recognition, grabber handle, and action sheet button groups.
16. GkAlert (<gk-alert>):
     Modal alert dialog featuring title, message, structured action buttons (cancel, destructive, default), focus trapping, and screen reader announcements.
17. GkList, GkListRow, GkListRowSeparator, GkSection (<gk-list>, etc.):
     Grouped and inset list views supporting single/multiple selection, roving keyboard navigation, section headers with titlecasing enforcement, section footers, leading/trailing accessories, disclosure chevrons, and interactive swipetoreveal action buttons (beginSwipe, positionSwipe, settleSwipe).
18. GkForm & GkFormRow (<gk-form>, <gk-form-row>):
     Structured form layout container supporting multicolumn responsive grid alignment, automatic labeltocontrol ID pairing (aria-labelledby), and description hints.
19. GkCard (<gk-card>):
     Container card supporting media slots, titles, subtitles, interactive glass hover/press physics, custom tints, and link navigation.
20. GkBadge (<gk-badge>):
     Notification badge supporting numeric counts with overflow caps (99+), unread dot presentation, and 3D rolling odometer vertical digit transition columns.
21. GkTooltip (<gk-tooltip>):
     Timed dwell hover/focus tooltip with automatic viewport edge collision avoidance and pointer enter/leave lifecycle management.
22. GkIcon (<gk-icon>):
     Vector iconography component with a builtin library of 40+ SVG symbols, rendering at multiple weights (thin, regular, medium, bold) and scales (small, medium, large).
23. GkAppIcon (<gk-app-icon>):
     Multilayer application icon renderer supporting superellipse and circular squircle masks, GPU/CPU compositing via Euclidean distance transforms, multilayer specular highlights, inner shadows, and light/dark/tinted/clear preview generation.
24. GkSplitView, GkPane, GkInspector, GkScrollView, GkSafeBar, GkWindowFrame (<gk-split-view>, etc.):
     Structural application layout primitives providing draggable multipane split views, collapsible inspector sidebars, scroll views with scrolldriven item transforms, sticky safearea bars, and rounded window frames.



 10. Public API Surface & Global Lifecycle

1. Master API Class & Singleton Export
    Construct the master API entry point exposing:
      Properties: version, settings, preferences, safeArea, metrics, Glass, Shape, GlassTransition, ScrollEdgeEffect, BackgroundExtension, and quality (tier getter/setter).
      mount(root, options): Initializes the WebGL canvas, starts the render scheduler, attaches resize and mutation observers, initializes accessibility listeners, and mounts global styling.
      unmount(): Disposes of the renderer, cleans up all WebGL resources, detaches observers, and resets registries.
      effect(el, glass, shape, opts): Directly binds glass materials to arbitrary DOM elements and returns a disposable handle.
      removeEffect(el): Removes glass bindings.
      audit(): Executes a comprehensive accessibility and performance audit across all active surfaces, returning violation counts, contrast measurements, and surface inventories.
2. Custom Element Registration
    Guard against duplicate registration and register all 40+ Custom Elements under the customElements registry using the gk-* tag prefix.
3. Execution & Return
    Ensure the module returns the master API singleton, cleanly packaged for immediate execution in any modern browser or modular environment.

I can’t provide a truly complete, productionready implementation of that entire specification in one response, because it is far too large to fit reliably here without omissions.[1]

What I can do next is build it in a practical, productionquality way by delivering the library in chunks, starting with the UMD core, math, color science, SDFs, physics, and the customelement framework, then layering in the WebGL renderer and component suite.[1]

 What I already prepared

I created a working UMD library skeleton in the workspace that exports correctly in CommonJS and browser environments, and it already includes runtime detection, a persistent storage fallback, an event bus, a Rect primitive, core interpolation utilities, color parsing, and Oklab conversion foundations.[1]

 Best path forward

The safest way to finish this is as a staged build:
1. Core utilities and math.
2. Color science, WCAG contrast engine, and spring physics.
3. SDF and scene graph helpers.
4. Virtual DOM, base customelement class, accessibility primitives.
5. WebGL context, shaders, render graph, and component registrations.[1]

If you want, I can continue immediately with the next chunk and keep everything dependencyfree and UMDcompatible.
